summary: Explains how the ISSN, the number used to identify serials such as magazines and journals, can be used within the URN framework as its own namespace. This document is historic and was replaced by RFC 8254.

eli5.summary: Magazines already have an ID number. This shows how to turn that number into a permanent Internet-style name. This note is old and was replaced.

questions: how to use issn as a urn
